name: Gosling Electrical Scholarship for Engineering (SCU)
summary: $15,000 over three years for a second-year SCU engineering student from, or willing to travel to, the Coffs Harbour region.
key: $15,000, paid as $5,000 per year for 3 years.
who: Enrolled in the second year of the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) at SCU.
Normally live in the Greater Coffs Harbour region or be willing to travel there.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with your transcript and a 100 to 200 word statement.
